summary: First week of Meta ads (they started Tue 20 Oct). The first four days spent Rp 183.519 with no orders — people added to cart but dropped at checkout (the 35% wasn't applied for guests and the ads still asked to register). After the checkout and homepage fixes, Sat–Sun brought 3 paid orders (Rp 1.080.000). The week ends ABOVE break-even: +Rp 170.842 profit after ads, ROAS 2,86×, Rp 125.849 ad cost per order. (Monday 26 Oct added 2 more orders — they'll be in next week's recap.)
worked: Fixing the funnel worked: guest checkout with the 35% applied automatically + "tanpa perlu daftar" ads + homepage banners → 0 orders before, 3 orders on Saturday–Sunday (and 2 more on Monday).
"Carousel 4 kartu v2" (taste story ending with the 35% ticket) is the winner: 68% of the spend and both orders with an ad tag. Meta now sends most budget there by itself.
Customers buy more than one pack: average order Rp 360.000 (2–4 packs), so they get free delivery and the margin stays healthy.
Tracking works end to end: Pixel + server purchases, ad source on each order, visits per source, courier fee in the profit.
improve: Don't change the campaign this week: Meta just started learning from real purchases (3 credited so far). Changes now would reset that learning.
Discounted Sapi-only first orders are thin (Monday's order #261020260002: Rp 41.445 before ads, below the ad cost per order). Watch whether these customers order again before changing anything.

Many buyers come back without an ad tag (27 "direct" visits, 4 opened checkout) — e.g. after a WhatsApp chat. It works, but it hides which ad brought them; when chatting, sending the website link keeps the tag.
Keep entering the courier fee for every order — the profit depends on it.

experiments.title: Second carousel: "Cara masak 3 langkah" next to the winning carousel
experiments.why: How-to posts get saved and shared; a second strong carousel can lower the cost per order and protects us if the current winner gets tired (same people seeing it again).
experiments.how: Add the ready-made 5-slide carousel as a new ad in the SAME ad set. Meta splits the same Rp 70.000/day between them.
experiments.measure: After 7 days and at least Rp 150.000 spend on the new ad: cost per paid order vs Carousel v2. Keep the cheaper one.

experiments.title: Re-order reminder on WhatsApp (no new promotion)
experiments.why: Profit comes from the second order (no ad cost, no 35%). The first 5 customers will run out in 1–2 weeks.
experiments.how: 10–14 days after delivery, you send a short WhatsApp: "Stok daging di freezer masih ada? Kalau mau pesan lagi: jentiskitchen.id" + mention their monthly 20% voucher (existing). I prepare the message and the list of customers each week.
experiments.measure: How many of these customers order again within 3 weeks.

experiments.title: Retargeting: remind people who added to cart but didn't buy (from next week)
experiments.why: 18 add-to-carts but only 3 orders this week — many interested people left.
experiments.how: Small separate ad set (Rp 15.000/day) shown only to website visitors of the last 14 days who didn't buy. To keep the Rp 500.000/week limit, the main ad set goes from Rp 70.000 to Rp 55.000/day.
experiments.cost: Same total budget (split differently). Needs about 100+ visitors in the audience first — we're close.
experiments.measure: Orders and cost per order from the retargeting ad set over 7 days.

decisions: Experiment 1 (second carousel, no extra cost): OK to add it?
Experiment 2 (WhatsApp re-order reminder, Rp 0): OK — should I prepare the message and customer list each Monday?
Experiment 3 (retargeting, same total budget): start it next Monday if the audience is big enough?
Budget: at this pace the Rp 2.000.000 test budget lasts until about mid-November. No decision needed yet — I'll ask again at 80%.
